evidence_items.locator: Section What's next for AI-enabled cybersecurity
evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic describes iterative tool use in discovering Firefox vulnerabilities, with human validation and Mozilla's involvement. This establishes an agent workflow rather than a one-response chatbot demonstration, although it is developer-reported evidence.

Mozilla confirms that its evaluation of Claude Mythos Preview produced many findings that were verified and fixed in a released browser. Together with the documented discovery workflow, this establishes repeated practical usefulness in a bounded task.

This study of production deployments identifies reliability and substantial human involvement as continuing constraints. It limits any broader conclusion about autonomous agents, but does not negate the verified security use case or establish permanent impossibility.

unresolved_gaps: The security disclosures do not provide a complete per-attempt success rate or establish reliability across unrelated tasks.
Mozilla was a collaboration partner, although it independently maintained the affected software and verified the practical results.
These later outcomes do not settle the present-tense assertion about agents on July 21, 2025.
